title: UDLF deployment config — Google Security Operations rules
description: Config for `platform: google-secops`. A Google SecOps (Chronicle) YARA-L rule and its deployment state. The rule text, including its `meta` section, lives in `detection_content` as a `yara-l` variant; `deployments[].enabled` is the rule deployment's `enabled`.

schema.description: Sub-schema revision this block was authored against, e.g. `google-secops::0.1.0`.

rule_id.description: SecOps rule id this deployment owns. SecOps assigns it on create, so it is absent until the rule exists; without it the deployer matches on the YARA-L rule name.

alerting.description: Whether the rule's detections raise alerts. Left as SecOps has it when omitted; SecOps creates rules with alerting off.

run_frequency.description: How often the rule runs. Must be one the rule allows: a multi-event rule with a long match window cannot run LIVE. Left as SecOps has it when omitted.
